Title: Simplify ML workloads with Azure Machine Learning events now in Event Grid

Body.Content:
Azure Machine Learning service is the latest event source for Azure Event Grid, enabling to trigger event-driven applications, business automation processes, or CI/CD workflows based on machine learning events. 

Now you can quickly respond to events happening on Azure Machine Learning - such as model registered, model deployed, run completed and dataset drift detected - using the Azure portal or CLI.

Learn more in docs
